name: core-strings
title: Core: strings by language
description: The library's own words in more than one language (decision 0025). strings(byLang, tag) lays the lookup chain for a language tag over English, never crossing a script, so a missing Konkani key reads in English and Romi never borrows Devanagari; langOf(el) reads the nearest lang; t() gives a string or calls a function entry; unreviewed() lists the entries no native reader has checked. strings.table.js holds the words several components share, in English and in placeholder Konkani (Devanagari and Romi).

budget.reason: Pure and tiny: tag handling and the chain (strings.js, 3,878 bytes) and the shared table (strings.table.js, 2,327 bytes) with every Konkani entry written in two scripts (Devanagari costs three bytes a letter). 6,205 bytes today; raised from 6144 on 7 October 2026 for the Konkani entries, with about 3% to spare.

motif.gloss: No cultural motif; shared infrastructure, nothing drawn from a tradition.
